defensiveAbilities.name: Deep Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: A castoroides can hold its breath for 1 hour.

defensiveAbilities.name: Slap
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The castoroides is targeted by a physical ranged Strike from an attacker it can see

Effect The castoroides swats at the projectile with its wide tail, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Construct Shelter
offensiveAbilities.description: The castoroides rapidly constructs a simple mound along one side of its space, which can be used to Take Cover.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gouge
offensiveAbilities.description: The castoroides deals 2d8 Piercing Damage damage to a creature it has Grabbed or Restrained (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw). A creature that fails its save also takes 1d4 Bleed Damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Penetrating Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: As beaver, but the castoroides's jaws Strike ignores the first 10 Hardness instead of the first 5 Hardness.

offensiveAbilities.name: Prop
offensiveAbilities.description: The castoroides stabilizes itself with its tail, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to its Fortitude and Reflex DCs against Shove and Trip attempts until it next takes an action with the move trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
